source.title: Letter 21
source.breadcrumbs: Home > Fathers of the Church > Letters of St. Jerome > Letter 21

notes.text: In this letter Jerome, at the request of Damasus, gives a minutely detailed explanation of the parable of the prodigal son.

source.source_note: Source. Translated by W.H. Fremantle, G. Lewis and W.G. Martley. From Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, Second Series, Vol. 6. Edited by Philip Schaff and Henry Wace. (Buffalo, NY: Christian Literature Publishing Co., 1893.) Revised and edited for New Advent by Kevin Knight. <http://www.newadvent.org/fathers/3001021.htm>.
